title: And called out coarsely:
html_source:
Of all the impressive literary techniques, wide-ranging vocabulary, and esoteric religious allusions, somehow “coarse” feels like the best word to describe Mulligan.

PROPOSED SUGGESTION: The word “coarsely” contains the word “arse” and Ulysses is crammed full of lewd half-jokes such as this.
